about: Display names and pet names that other people see are checked against these terms, on the server (src/names.ts) and in the app (TabbiKitCore/Party/PartyNameFilter.swift), which must agree. Text is decomposed, stripped of accents, lowercased and passed through substitutions; a character listed under ambiguous is tried as each of its letters. Every other non-letter separates words, as does a change from lower to upper case; a run of single letters (f.u.c.k) joins into one word. A term matches with any of its letters repeated (fuuuck). anywhere terms match inside any word and across separators, so they must have no innocent superstrings; words terms match only a whole word (plus a plural s or es) or the whole joined name (without a last single-letter initial, so Ana L. passes). allow lists harmless words that contain an anywhere term; they are removed before the anywhere check. Terms are letters a-z only.
